heading: Tuesday
text: Mostly sunny south; variable clouds north, becoming mostly sunny this afternoon. Valley highs from the mid 30s to around 40, some lower 30s northeast and in the Adirondacks. West to northwest winds decreasing 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 15 mph.

heading: Tuesday Night
text: A few evening clouds, then mainly clear. Lows from the mid to upper teens & lower 20s in the southern valleys and around Lake Champlain. Winds becoming light and variable.

heading: Wednesday
text: Sun filtering through occasional high clouds. High temperatures from the mid 30s to around 40 north, and low to mid 40s in the south. Light and variable winds.
